game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against goblin raiders.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against goblin raiders. Each round, goblin raiders strike the royal seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the potion value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal seal from goblin raiders in Royal Stables: keep the potion meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: potion drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 10 (extended tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Royal Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Royal Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while potion > 0.
